quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 18

questions.question: To pass a slower-moving vehicle on a two-lane road with traffic coming toward you, you must:

options.text: Flash your lights at oncoming traffic.
Use the lane with oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane with oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: To pass safely on a two-lane road, you must use the lane with oncoming traffic to complete the pass. Only pass if it is safe and legal.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with sirens and/or flashing lights approaches you, you must immediately:

options.text: Pull to the right and stop.
Pull to the right and slow down.
Pull to the right and turn on your four-way flashers.
Stop and let the emergency vehicle pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle uses its lights and sirens, you must move to the right side of the road and stop immediately.

questions.question: When driving where children are playing, you should expect them to:

options.text: Know when it is safe to cross the street.
Stop at the curb before crossing the street.
Run out in front of you without looking.
Not cross the street unless with an adult.

questions.correctAnswerText: Run out in front of you without looking.
questions.explanation: Slow down and be extra careful around children. They may not understand danger and could run in front of your vehicle without checking first.

questions.question: If you see an animal on the road, you should:

options.text: Pass the animal as close as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be very cautious.
questions.explanation: Be very careful when you see an animal on the road. Pass it slowly to avoid startling it.

questions.question: When driving in rain, you must:
questions.correctAnswerText: Use low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: In rain, use your low beam headlights.

questions.question: When the road has a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line next to your lane, you may pass if:
questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is clear.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to your lane and a solid yellow line is next to the other lane, you may cross to pass only if there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: To help prevent crashes, you should:

options.text: Ignore other drivers on the road.
Drive only on side streets and back roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Communicate with other road users.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers do unexpected things. Communicate with other drivers, cyclists, and pedestrians by signaling when you slow down, stop, or change direction. Use your signals and horn when needed.

questions.question: When turning onto a street with more than one lane in your direction, you should:

options.text: Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane.
Turn into the lane marked with an arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes in your direction, turn into the lane closest to where you came from. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: A green arrow with a red light means:

options.text: You may only drive straight ahead.
You may only drive in the direction of the green arrow.
You must wait for a solid green light to go in any direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may only drive in the direction of the green arrow.
questions.explanation: A green arrow with a red light lets you drive only in the direction of the arrow, and only if the intersection is clear.

questions.question: When you must stop at an intersection with no stop line or crosswalk markings, you should:

options.text: Slow down to check if crossing traffic is clear.
Stop where you can see at least 200 feet in both directions, even if you enter the other roadway.
Stop where you can clearly see approaching traffic before entering the other roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop where you can clearly see approaching traffic before entering the other roadway.
questions.explanation: If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop at the point closest to the other roadway where you can see approaching traffic. Do not enter the other roadway just to get a better view.

questions.question: Does drinking coffee after drinking alcohol affect your blood alcohol level?

options.text: It lowers your blood alcohol level.
It has no effect on your blood alcohol level.
It raises your blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has no effect on your blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee cannot lower your blood alcohol level. It may keep you awake, but it does not make you sober or change your blood alcohol level.

questions.question: What should drivers do when entering a roundabout?

options.text: Yield to cars already in the roundabout.
Yield to cars entering the roundabout.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to cars already in the roundabout.
questions.explanation: A roundabout is a circular intersection with no traffic signal. Enter from the right and yield to cars already inside. Follow the circle to the right until you reach your exit.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light has the same rules as:
questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: When you see a flashing red light, you must stop and let all other traffic pass.

questions.question: When must you yield for emergency vehicles?

options.text: When you see flashing red or blue lights or hear a siren.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see flashing red or blue lights or hear a siren.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any emergency vehicle that is using its siren or flashing lights.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Road hazard warning.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are yellow warning signs. Orange diamond signs are used in work zones. These signs warn you of hazards ahead or areas with special rules.

questions.question: What should you do when you see or hear an emergency vehicle?

options.text: Stop immediately and let it pass.
Move safely to the right side of the road and stop.
Drive slowly and let the vehicle pass.
Keep moving slowly on the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move safely to the right side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: On a two-lane road, yield to an emergency vehicle using lights or a siren. Move as far right as safely possible and stop. Do not stop in an intersection.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and you must always obey them.
questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with black markings. They control traffic and must always be obeyed by drivers.

questions.question: What headlights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: It does not matter which lights you use.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beams.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pass.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing a bicycle because the cyclist may suddenly swerve to avoid something on the road. Always drive carefully near cyclists.

questions.question: What does a slow-moving vehicle emblem look like?
questions.correctAnswerText: A triangular orange sign.
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this sign are driving 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: If you drink alcohol socially, what helps ensure safe driving?

options.text: Ride home with a friend who has not been drinking.
Take a cold shower before driving.
Stop drinking one half hour before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride home with a friend who has not been drinking.
questions.explanation: The safest way to avoid drunk driving is to get a ride home with a sober friend. Coffee and cold showers do not reduce alcohol in your blood. The body needs about one hour to process one drink.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
Alerts drivers to public recreation areas.
Alerts drivers to upcoming food and gas locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: A leaky exhaust system in your vehicle is dangerous because it can cause:
questions.correctAnswerText: Carbon monoxide poisoning.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes harmful gases from your vehicle. A leak lets poisonous carbon monoxide enter the passenger area. Fix leaks right away.

questions.question: If someone has consumed alcoholic drinks, what will help the person overcome the influence of those drinks?
questions.correctAnswerText: Only time
questions.explanation: Only time allows the body to overcome the effects of alcohol.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves sharply. Slow down before reaching a sharp curve, just as you would at an intersection.
